high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from a news article detailing damage to Iran's Kermanshah missile facility. The text at the top of the image states: "Damage to Iran's Kermanshah missile facility. Damage to at least 15 buildings and other areas of the Kermanshah missile facility can be seen in satellite imagery from June 16, 2025 after repeated strikes by Israel." The image includes two main parts: Satellite Imagery Map: The map shows the location of the Kermanshah missile facility relative to Tehran, Iran.
